items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to requiring the
pre-licensing course to include information on organ and tissue donation and
how to register as an organ donor
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S2739

SPONSOR: COMRIE
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to requiring
the pre-licensing course to include information on organ and tissue
donation and how to register as an organ donor

 
PURPOSE:

This bill would include information about organ and tissue donation and
about how to register as an organ donor in the course required in order
receiving a New York State driver's license.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

This bill amends subparagraph (i) of paragraph (a) of subdivision 4 of
section 502 of the vehicle and traffic law, as amended by chapter 57 of
the laws of 2016 to read as follows: Upon submission of an application
for a driver's license, the applicant shall be required to take and pass
a test, or submit evidence of passage of a test, with respect to the
laws relating to traffic, the laws relating to driving while ability is
impaired and while intoxicate, under the overpowering influence of "road
rage", or "work zone safety" and law relating to exercising due care to
avoid colliding with a parked, stopped or standing authorized emergency
vehicle or hazard vehicle pursuant to section eleven hundred
forty-four-a of this chapter, the ability to read and comprehend traffic
signs and symbols and such matters as the commissioner of riot less than
four hours and not more than five hours, consisting of classroom driver
training and highway safety instruction or the equivalent thereof, and
shall also include information on organ and tissue donation and how to
registeròas an organ donor.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

There are currently over 10,000 candidates waiting for organ donations
in New York State and every year over 3,000 candidates are added to the
waiting list. The supply of available organs falls well short of meeting
the needs of these candidates, and New York is working to educate people
and increase the number of people registered as organ donors. One of the
more successful efforts to increase donation consent rates has been
Lauren's Law which provides an opportunity to register as a donor as
part of a Department of Motor Vehicle application for a driver's
license. Becoming a licensed driver already requires that an applicant
take a 5 hour course on various aspects of driving and this bill
requires that the course include information on organ and tissue
donation and how to register. Including this information as part of the
driving course is appropriate and justified so that people become more
familiar and Knowledgeable about this important issue and decision. This
bill seeks to bolster the number of .registered organ donors among New
York state drivers by creating greater awareness of the registration
process and the vital role organ donation plays in saving the lives of
others.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2015-2016: A10338- Referred to Transportation

2017: A.7549 - Referred to Transportation

2022: S5509

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE: :
January 1st after enactment.
